title: BFF-ADM-064 current BFF administration through actual UI

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given Admin A uses subject "admin-a" with role "FMO_ADMIN" in an isolated authenticated browser
2. And the controlled Import Map fixture records the initial grid rows and persisted values
3. And the Import Map grid has record "101" owned by "FMO_ADMIN"
4. And the baseline fixture data defines "Module Name" as "container-064"
5. And the baseline fixture data defines "Path" as "https://fixture.example/case-064.js"
6. And Import Map record "101" is inactive when this browser loads its grid
8. When Admin A clicks the button labeled "Verify" in the Import Map grid row with "Record Id" "101"
9. Then the dialog titled "verify ID: 101" is visible on the Import Map administration page
10. When Admin A clicks the button labeled "Verified" in dialog "verify ID: 101"
11. Then the alert with severity "error" in the portal snackbar contains the exact text "Maker and Checker should be different user."
12. And in the Import Map data grid with column "Record Id", the "Verified?" cell for Import Map record "101" has status tooltip "Unverified or Deactivated" on the Import Map administration page
13. And the persisted-record readback for record "101" has "active" equal to false
